description: Make a stopped workflow run self-consistent: WorkflowRun.Stop() clears the current stage's residual awaiting-approval gate, and a factored idempotent reconcile also self-heals already-persisted dirty records (e.g. #331) on grain reactivation. No new events, no projection/mapper/frontend changes.

tasks.title: Stop clears residual approval gate and self-heals dirty persisted runs
tasks.description: Extend WorkflowRun.Stop() so that when the current stage IsAwaitingApproval it nulls ApprovalStatus and flips StageRunStatus off AwaitingApproval, mirroring the existing approval-invalidation in AddRuntimeTasks (WorkflowRun.Work.cs:94-98). Factor the cleanup into a new idempotent domain method (e.g. bool ReconcileStoppedApprovalGate(), sibling to ReconcileReadyStatusWithInFlightWork in Shared.cs) guarded by `current.IsAwaitingApproval` (NOT `run.Status == Stopped` — at the Stop() call site the run is not yet Stopped, so a Stopped-only guard would make the cleanup a no-op and leave the gate dangling on every fresh stop), returning whether state changed; call it from Stop() before the Stopped transition, and from WorkflowGrain.OnActivateAsync over rehydrated state only when `run.Status == Stopped` (so a live run genuinely awaiting approval is never disturbed), with write-back (mirroring the existing ReconcileReadyStatusWithInFlightWork reconcile at WorkflowGrain.cs:67-74). Stop() continues to return only [WorkflowRunStopped] — no StageApprovalResolved. Downstream consumers (WorkflowStatusMapper, IssueQuerier, MohistDefaultWorkflowProjection.StageApprovals, board) need no code change.
acceptanceCriteria: WorkflowRun.Stop() lands the run on Stopped and, when the current stage was awaiting approval, leaves that stage's ApprovalStatus == null and StageRunStatus != AwaitingApproval (spec scenario 1).
When the current stage is not awaiting approval (Running/Ready), Stop() leaves ApprovalStatus unchanged from its pre-stop value (spec scenario 2).

New ReconcileStoppedApprovalGate() is idempotent: guarded by current.IsAwaitingApproval; returns true only when it mutated state; no-op on already-clean runs (so repeated grain activations don't write-amplify). The OnActivateAsync caller scopes invocation to Stopped runs so a live run genuinely awaiting approval is never cleared.

A run persisted as Stopped but with a non-null unresolved current-stage ApprovalStatus is corrected the next time its grain activates (OnActivateAsync calls the reconcile and writes back the cleaned State) — covers #331-class dirty records without a data migration (spec requirement 2 / scenario 3).
Stop() returns events containing WorkflowRunStopped and never a StageApprovalResolved (or any approval-resolution) event (spec requirement 3).

The stage is left as Running (not Completed) when cleared, matching the AddRuntimeTasks pattern and existing stop-from-Ready semantics; a code comment at the cleanup site notes the rationale (run-level Stopped is authoritative).

Unit specs pass: extend WorkflowRunStatusTransitionSpecs.cs (Stop_LandsOnStopped) with awaiting-approval-stop assertions, plus a ReconcileStoppedApprovalGate_CorrectsPersistedDirtyRun spec mirroring the ReconcileReadyStatusWithInFlightWork test; `npm test` is green and TreatWarningsAsErrors stays clean.

Spec domain coverage: all four requirements and their scenarios in specs/workflow-run-stop/spec.md are exercised (stop-clears-gate, non-awaiting-unaffected, persisted-dirty-corrected, no-approval-event).
tasks.output: Modified WorkflowRun.Lifecycle.cs (Stop()), Shared.cs (new ReconcileStoppedApprovalGate), WorkflowGrain.cs (OnActivateAsync reconcile + write-back), and extended stop/reconcile specs in WorkflowRunStatusTransitionSpecs.cs.
tasks.notes: Design decisions D1–D4 in design.md. Keep the blast radius to the domain method + grain rehydration hook only — do NOT touch WorkflowStatusMapper, MohistDefaultWorkflowProjection, IssueQuerier, ClearExecutableStateAsync, or the web layer (per proposal Non-Goals; consumers read the cleaned domain state). The reconcile-on-activate path emits no events, consistent with ReconcileReadyStatusWithInFlightWork.
